title: NIST WebBook: Sucrose is C12H22O11, molecular weight 342.2965 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Sucrose as C12H22O11, molecular weight 342.2965 amu, CAS 57-50-1.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Sucrose, CAS Registry Number 57-50-1, lists molecular formula C12H22O11 and molecular weight 342.2965 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 342.1162115 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/C12H22O11/c13-1-4-6(16)8(18)9(19)11(21-4)23-12(3-15)10(20)7(17)5(2-14)22-12/h4-11,13-20H,1-3H2/t4-,5?,6-,7?,8+,9-,10?,11-,12?/m0/s1. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
